title: Hedge Mazes
description:
One of my first college projects, from the early days of building Windows console apps with C++.

This was a chance to learn about and implement a **maze generation** algorithm, as well as play with rendering, controls, collectables, and level progression.

![](assets/projects/college/hedge-mazes/screenshot-2.webp)

![](assets/projects/college/hedge-mazes/screenshot-3.webp)

![](assets/projects/college/hedge-mazes/screenshot-1.webp)

I revisited the project two years later, this time with a proper square grid and a cheap **fog of war** effect by rendering a circle around the player as they move, leaving behind a dim map of where they've been.

![](assets/projects/college/hedge-mazes/screenshot-4.webp)

![](assets/projects/college/hedge-mazes/screenshot-5.webp)

In 2022, I built a small Windows [command prompt emulator](https://github.com/tjvezina/cmd-emulator) in **p5.js** so I could recreate this and other projects in a web context, and keep them alive and playable for longer.
